title: Confirmation of frozen On-Adapter variants on the V1 three-seed benchmark (seeds 2025, 2026, 2027)
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, before any confirmation trajectory (one Traffic H6 seed-2025 smoke training cell of the primary method excepted)
primary_method: On-Adapter-CV = round-12 seed-2 validation-selected method: a0e15 recipe (VICReg alignment off, On epochs 15, patience 3, checkpoint by validation MSE) + CVaR90 variational tail loss lambda 0.5 (tau = cross-batch EMA of the batch 90% quantile) + backbone-first abstaining gate (gs 0.9, mu 0, kmin 4); online parameter updates off (lr 0)
control_method: On-Adapter-TA = round-5 configuration (a0e15 recipe with MSE loss + the same gate), reported alongside; it cannot replace the primary after the fact
no_selection: No hyperparameter, candidate, seed or stream is selected in this confirmation; every choice above was fixed on seed 2 before this plan.
baselines: Fixed V1 main table (reports/benchmark_textrepair_v1_20261008/results.json, frozen score.py): iTransformer, ADAPT-Z, DSOF, Proceed (reused legacy text-free cells) and GPT4MTS, MM-TSFlib, original On-Adapter (V1 campaign). Not rerun.
backbone: the same V1 legacy iTransformer checkpoints (legacy_numeric_reuse_manifest) per domain/H/seed
online_entry_state: python/numpy/torch seeded with 100*s (s = training seed), stream r=0, CPU float32 2 threads
scoring: frozen benchmark_textrepair_v1/score.py definitions: per cell CVaR90 / same-cell iTransformer CVaR90, seed mean per domain/H, equal-weight geometric mean over 36 tasks; mean CVaR90 rank over 108 domain/H/seed cells; MAE, MSE, CVaR90, per domain/H; pre-gate and adapter share reported
success: primary S strictly below all six other methods
disclosure: Seeds 2025-2027 differ only in training randomness; their test time period is the same one used during seed-2 development, so this confirms robustness to training randomness, not generalisation to unseen data. The V1 three-seed main table was produced earlier and has been seen.
